plugins.name: pr-review
plugins.description: Automatic review loop for your own GitHub PRs: a listener session spawns a background reviewer per PR, which comments, notifies the authoring session, and re-reviews every new push until all threads are resolved.

plugins.name: switchboard
plugins.description: Run all your Claude sessions from one operator session on your phone: it receives every session's final reply, messages sessions back, answers their dialogs and opens new sessions in tmux.
